dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge follows a concave spline curve, exhibiting moderate falcation from the posterior insertion point to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The apex is characterized as rounded with a smooth pixel boundary, forming a non-acute morphological peak.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The leading edge presents a convex slope with an approximate 45-degree angle relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of the fin's maximum base width to its vertical height is approximately 1.1:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white punctate depigmentation or small lesions are concentrated on the lateral epidermis below the dorsal fin; no macro-scale notches are visible on the fin margins.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct high-contrast white speckling pattern distributed across the dark dorsal and lateral surfaces.
